recommendation_summary: Set up a free Healthchecks.io daily dead man's switch that the nightly-sync script pings as its last step, so the user gets emailed if no ping arrives by about 04:00.

labels.Requirements and who asked: You want to find out within a day when `nightly-sync` doesn't finish, without reading logs. Nobody needs a central log for that; logs only help if someone reads them.
labels.Deleted: The central log on the Synology, Docker, and any log collection or dashboard.
labels.Bottleneck: Your only signal is the success email, so a run that dies early produces silence, and silence looks like nothing happened.
labels.Checked myself: Only what you told me: one cron job at 03:00 on `edna`, a summary email at the end, four startup crashes from an expired token, no other alerting, and a Synology that can run Docker. I haven't seen the script or crontab.

note: The reply recommends one hosted heartbeat check, drops the central log and Docker stack, and gives a specific record that comes before the recommendation and sticks to the given facts.
